# iru_device (List Resource)

Lists existing `iru_device` objects for `terraform query`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every device on one blueprint, with config for import.
list "iru_device" "core" {
  provider         = iru
  include_resource = true
  config {
    blueprint_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `blueprint_id` (String) Only list devices on the blueprint with this ID.
